📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: August 1, 2026)

On Saturday, August 1, I visited the Hanno City Museum to see the Showa Centennial Exhibition "Hanno and the Showa Era – The City's Birth and Evolving Life."

Reiwa 8 (2026) marks 100 years since the beginning of the Showa era.

This exhibition introduces the history of how the current Hanno city area took shape through successive municipal mergers, and how people's daily lives have changed alongside various furniture and home appliances. The displays center on materials from the museum's collection.

The exhibition runs through Sunday, August 30, so if you're interested, please visit. I hope the exhibition offers an opportunity to reflect on the future by tracing the city's history woven from the Showa, Heisei, and Reiwa eras, and observing how people's lives and activities have evolved during this time.
